name: robots/quincy-u__ego_humanoid_manipulation_benchmark
title: EgoVLA Humanoid-Base-v0 (Isaac Lab benchmark)
intro: EgoVLA Humanoid-Base-v0 (Isaac Lab benchmark), adapted from quincy-u/ego_humanoid_manipulation_benchmark. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
